variants.prompt: REFORM MOOD/EXPRESSION: In a sultry, neon-lit nightclub, she sits on a plush, black velvet banquette, her olive-toned skin almost glowing under the pulsing lights. The daring black leather jacket and tight red dress are now a daring, sheer black lace corset that leaves little to the imagination. Her raven-black hair is styled in an edgy, asymmetrical bob, while her smoldering amber eyes hold an intense, dominant gaze as she looks straight into the camera lens. A DSLR captures her in a tight, shallow focus medium shot, the blurred dance floor and strobing lights creating a sense of movement and energy.
